question: What was net revenue by month in the first half of 2026?

sql.text:
WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_TS, o.REGION_CODE, o.CHANNEL_CODE
    FROM METRICGUARD.ORDERS o
    WHERE o.STATUS IN (CAST(? AS VARCHAR(16)))
      AND o.ORDER_TS >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND o.ORDER_TS < CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
),
line_refunds AS (
    -- Pre-aggregate refunds per order line BEFORE joining (no fan-out).
    SELECT r.ORDER_ITEM_ID, SUM(r.REFUND_AMOUNT) AS REFUND_AMOUNT
    FROM METRICGUARD.REFUNDS r
    JOIN eligible_orders e ON e.ORDER_ID = r.ORDER_ID
    WHERE r.STATUS = CAST(? AS VARCHAR(12))
    GROUP BY r.ORDER_ITEM_ID
),
line_facts AS (
    SELECT e.ORDER_ID, e.ORDER_TS, e.REGION_CODE, e.CHANNEL_CODE, p.CATEGORY,
           (i.QUANTITY * i.UNIT_PRICE) - i.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT AS LINE_REVENUE,
           COALESCE(lr.REFUND_AMOUNT, 0) AS LINE_REFUND
    FROM eligible_orders e
    JOIN METRICGUARD.ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = e.ORDER_ID
    JOIN METRICGUARD.PRODUCTS p ON p.PRODUCT_ID = i.PRODUCT_ID
    LEFT JOIN line_refunds lr ON lr.ORDER_ITEM_ID = i.ORDER_ITEM_ID
)
SELECT VARCHAR_FORMAT(f.ORDER_TS, 'YYYY-MM') AS ORDER_MONTH,
       CAST(COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REVENUE), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(f.LINE_REFUND), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NET_REVENUE
FROM line_facts f
GROUP BY VARCHAR_FORMAT(f.ORDER_TS, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY ORDER_MONTH ASC
FETCH FIRST 101 ROWS ONLY
